_doc: VFX presets: trees of real Roblox instances (see src/asset_agent/vfx.py for the format). Sizes are studs for a ~4 stud object; an effect's size/rate multiply them. score: the user's 1-10 rating. source.kind: original (hand-made) | creator_store (imported, keep asset_id for credit/licence).

sparkles.note: I see the use case for this but not amazing

card_glint.use: a stealable card: slow glints so it reads as valuable
card_glint.note: same thing I can see the use case so its good

steal_burst.use: on the thief right after a steal: gold and green sparks flying out

speed_aura.use: speed upgrades: blue flames licking up from the feet

speed_trail.use: while sprinting: thin white wind streaks left behind

money_pop.use: a money generator paying out: green glints rising

rarity_rare.use: rare wheel prize: calm blue sparkle halo

rarity_epic.use: epic wheel prize: purple swirl around the item

rarity_legendary.use: legendary prize: gold light pillar shooting up

rarity_mythic.use: mythic prize: rainbow swirl with sparkles, the big one

aura_dark.use: an RNG-style rolled aura: dark red smoke with embers
